info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Streaming Subscriptions Trials-v1-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscription Trials API allows businesses to access and manage trial subscriptions for streaming services. This endpoint provides a comprehensive list of ongoing trial subscriptions, enabling users to analyze usage patterns and manage their subscription offerings effectively. Typical consumers of this API include service providers and developers who seek to monitor trial engagement and optimize customer acquisition strategies. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can enhance user experiences and fine-tune marketing efforts related to streaming trials.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details of the trial subscriptions available in the system. You can use this to understand the different trial options provided to users.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving trial subscription details. The body should be in JSON format and may include additional information as defined in the schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the trial subscription details.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsTrialsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the 'GET' operation related to subscriptions trial. It is a placeholder response in string format.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsTrialsResponse.title: Trial Subscription Response

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the subscription request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the subscription operation.

state.description: Current state of the trial subscription.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the request.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsTrialsResponse.description: Response object for the trial subscription operation which includes the status and details of the subscription request.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Username or identifier of the user who created the subscription.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the subscription was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the subscription was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of the subscription request.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time (in milliseconds) taken to process the request. A lower value generally indicates a faster response.
